+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9180'
+title: Render AVK's long and looped text from Stencil templates
+---
+User decision (2026-11-05): add Stencil to AgentViewKit as a direct dependency. The text audit (^688qj5d) left nine places that build longer text in loops:
+- **T1:** ThreadExporter, the Markdown export.
+- **T2:** AgentCommandTarget.plainText, the copy text.
+- **T3:** the plan "Steps" inspector field.
+- **T4:** ElicitationView field error text.
+- **T5:** the four "A › B › C" paths: the who-asks visible line, SessionPathText.label, SessionJumpList.pathText and the SessionTreeBanners explanation.
+
+## What
+- Add Stencil (the same package and version the skills use, found through FoundationModelsExtras' manifest) as a direct dependency of AgentViewKit.
+- Templates live as bundle resources, loaded through one small AVK renderer. Render each from a plain model value.
+- T1, T2 and T3 become templates.
+- For T4 and T5, prefer one catalog format string per item plus the locale's list or path pattern if that's cleaner than a template. Decide per site and record why. Separators and order belong in templates or the catalog, never in code.
+- Localizable words inside templates come from the catalog, passed in the model, unless the template itself is localized. Record the approach.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Each converted site keeps its output for a fixed locale, as characterization tests, plus a test that a template edit changes the output with no code change.
+- [ ] Full AVK suite green, zero AVK warnings.
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m6pftr3prkb6qrp6ef3j654f
+  text: |-
+    Picked up in worktree agent-a610a7bbaad73bfd0 (merged c905c28e; .build seeded from AVK root; `swift package update` in root, IntegrationTests, ScreenshotTests, no pins).
+
+    ### Research
+    - Stencil URL/version from FoundationModelsExtras manifest: https://github.com/stencilproject/Stencil.git exact 0.15.1 (Extras `TemplateEngine`). Added to the `AgentViewKit` target only; AgentViewKitStyle does not link it.
+    - Stencil 0.15.1 notes: no autoescape (Markdown passes verbatim); `{%-`/`-%}` trim all whitespace+newlines next to the tag (used to drop the leading comment line break and the file's final newline); `{# #}` comments cannot trim; struct models resolve through Mirror; `{% include %}` renders in the current context, so `message-markdown` sees the loop var `message`. FileSystemLoader needs PathKit `Path`, so the kit has its own `TemplateFolderLoader` (URL based, `nonisolated` for the MainActor default isolation).
+    - Pre-existing catalog gap: `Path: %@` (SessionPathText.label) had no catalog entry; added with this change. `" › "` key is gone (path pattern replaces it).
+    - InspectionText.text(of:) was a second copy of the content Markdown join (`"\n\n"` in code); it now calls ThreadExporter.markdown(for:) and so the message-markdown template.
+
+    ### Decisions (also in Docs/decisions/text-templates.md)
+    - T1 ThreadExporter (transcript + content forms): templates `thread-markdown` (includes `message-markdown`) and `message-markdown`.
+    - T2 AgentCommandTarget.plainText: template `copy-text`; role line is catalog `copy-text.role-line` (`%@:`) over the sender name, so the colon is localizable.
+    - T3 plan Steps field: template `plan-steps` over the catalog `inspection.plan-step` text of each step.
+    - T4 field/form error text: CATALOG — per-field `“%1$@”: %2$@` plus sentence pattern `chain.sentences` (`%1$@ %2$@`). Why: the parts are catalog sentences and the sentence separator is language dependent (none in ja/zh); an unlocalized template would fix one space for all languages.
+    - T5 the four paths: CATALOG — `chain.visible-path` (`%1$@ › %2$@`) for who-asks visible line, SessionJumpList.pathText and the WaitingDescendantBanner explanation; `chain.spoken-path` (`%1$@, then %2$@`) inside `Path: %@` for SessionPathText.label. Why: a path is a uniform chain with one separator; the pattern lets a language change the separator or the order (RTL); Foundation list styles have no path/sentence form. `ChainText` applies the two-part pattern left to right, as CLDR list patterns are applied.
+    - Words reach templates through the model as catalog text (sender names, role lines, step lines); templates hold only layout (`## `, line breaks), so none is localized.
+
+    ### Unrelated failure found and fixed
+    - `swift package update` moved EditorKit 2b0d42e2 → 8141595; EK ^ndc5zww added a stored `buttons: Buttons` field to `EditorStyle`, so `ViewValueLayoutTests.theStyleHasNoPaddingByte` failed (34 uncovered bytes). Fixed in AVK's test by listing `\.buttons`, plus `theButtonTokensHaveNoPaddingByte` for `EditorStyle.Buttons` (same pattern as the other token tests). No EK edit.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-05T18:34:08.886386+00:00
 position_column: doing
 position_ordinal: 9b80
 title: Render AVK's long and looped text from Stencil templates
